criteria.requirement: Account for every clause of the original frozen construction demand using explicit scenarios and scored observations. A declared limitation cannot waive a demanded observable. Missing support is fail or unverified, not inferred coverage.
criteria.evidence: Original demand, original source and exact scenario/check records; trace requirements to measurements, not check counts.

criteria.requirement: Trace actual initial state, ordered operations, exceptions, earlier effects and later skipped effects. Explain the source-supported observation mechanism; do not classify reachable state as unobservable merely because it is absent from the returned value.
criteria.evidence: Original field initialization, tested body, scenario initialState/inputs/expectedObservations and corresponding checks.

criteria.requirement: Trace every valid alternative and wrong control through the declared scenarios. A textual mutation is insufficient: its changed effect must be reachable and distinguishable by a scored observation. An unchanged fallback or unexercised branch cannot support a predicted failure set.
criteria.evidence: Original operation, exact edits, scenario state and inputs, and every predicted check difference; static opinion remains subject to real control execution.

criteria.requirement: Account for source-loading and transitive module initialization as well as tested method execution. Explain exact imports, required globals, declared seams and pinned compiler/runtime limitations. Do not invent default platform stubs or claim device behavior from host execution.
criteria.evidence: Loaded source and read-only dependency inventory, import/global usages, design seam outcomes and explicit proposed environment; unavailable execution proof remains unverified where required.
